settingsNotify.whenClosed.name: Notify with the window closed
settingsNotify.whenClosed.desc: Sent by the app itself, not by the UI window: a background command that finishes, a turn that settles or a permission gate still reaches you after you close the window. Turn this off and those events stay silent until you reopen AWOG.
settingsNotify.whenClosed.reach: Desktop only. Phones are notified while the Remote app is connected over the tailnet — AWOG sends nothing to an outside push service.
